name: @envpilot/docker-image
description: Docker image that pulls Envpilot variables and secret files into a build or a running container
author: Envpilot <hello@envpilot.dev> (https://www.envpilot.dev)

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile build/linux/amd64/envpilot && bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile build/linux/arm64/envpilot
